name: vm_exec
description: Run a PowerShell script on the Windows robot VM and get its output. The VM is a persistent Windows Server with git, node, and corepack/pnpm on PATH. Use it to clone a repo, install dependencies, run a Playwright spec, and inspect files or logs. Returns the exit code, the last 32000 chars of merged stdout+stderr, and the bucket path of the complete log.

Script.description: PowerShell script to run on the VM. Multiple lines allowed. Runs with powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass.

WorkDir.description: Working directory on the VM. Always pass the same value across calls so a clone survives between calls. Default is %TEMP%\vm-agent.

RunId.description: Log grouping prefix in the storage bucket. Pass the runId given to you.

TimeoutMinutes.description: Kill the script after this many minutes. Exit code 124 means it timed out.

OutputBlobPath.description: Path of the complete log inside the e2e-investigations bucket
